What's different
Price Ladder
  • 30 candlesticks instead of a single thin line — actual OHLC visible
  • EMA20 (amber) + EMA50 (blue) overlay — see the trend
  • Volume sub-plot below + 20d avg dashed line — see institutional activity
  • R-multiples (31.5R, 10.5R, -1R) shown on every key level
  • Stop zone + entry zone + T1/T2 zones as gradient-filled rectangles, not just hairlines
  • Foot row with 5 cells: T2 · T1 · Entry · SPOT · STOP with $ + % + R-multiples
  • Meta row: SPOT · 20d range · ATR · RVOL · RSI
Composite Score
  • Bigger 270° gauge (vs 180°) with tick marks at 65 / 75 / 85 thresholds
  • Zone bands behind the score (red <65, amber 65-75, green 75+) for instant context
  • "−23 to BUY" subtitle quantifies the gap (vs vague "SUB-THRESHOLD")
  • 5-pillar contribution bars below — see which pillar is dragging the composite
  • Stats row: 5d Δ, 30d Δ, percentile rank, BAP
5-Pillar Radar
  • 4 concentric rings at 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 with scale labels
  • Dashed BUY threshold ring at 65 overlaid so you can see which pillars clear
  • Vertex dots on each pillar — clearer than a flat outline
  • Pillar names + numeric values on the outside
  • Pill row at bottom for color-coded glance read
  • Tip: "broad weakness" — text summary of the radar shape
